description: Read agent-monitoring traces from Sentry: the traces a T3 thread produced and each trace's operations, durations and errors.

env.name: SENTRY_URL
env.title: Sentry URL
env.description: https://sentry.io, a regional host such as https://us.sentry.io, or your self-hosted Sentry.

env.name: SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
env.title: Sentry auth token
env.description: An organization or user auth token with org:read and event:read.
